title.narrative: KULIMA Multi-annual Programme Estimate (PE)

description.narrative: The purpose of the project, and therefore of this programme estimate, is to coordinate and provide complementary support to improve the delivery and performance of public sector research and extension services, and to attract investment into irrigation so as to achieve increased agricultural productivity and diversification of crop production in the context of a changing climate.
